title: Project scaffolding (Python)
body:
Goal: create the Python project layout and base package structure.

Scope:
- src/ package with clear module boundaries (domain, services, adapters)
- tests/ package with pytest discovery
- dependency file (pyproject.toml or requirements.txt)
- minimal entrypoint for CLI demo

Acceptance Criteria:
- pytest runs with a placeholder test
- import paths are stable and documented

Rubric focus: Design & Code Quality, Testing readiness

title: Domain model (Digital ID)
body:
Goal: implement the core Digital ID aggregate and value objects.

Scope:
- DigitalId, Status, Restriction, StatusHistory
- immutable vs mutable attributes
- deterministic transition rules

Acceptance Criteria:
- immutable attributes enforced (id, national_id, date_of_birth)
- status history recorded with timestamps
- restriction model supports optional periods

Rubric focus: Functionality, Design Quality

title: Repository layer (in-memory)
body:
Goal: create repository abstraction and in-memory implementation.

Scope:
- repository interface
- in-memory repository with indexes

Acceptance Criteria:
- CRUD operations supported
- lookup by id and national_id
- clear errors for missing records
- tests cover repository behavior

Rubric focus: Design Quality, Maintainability

title: Authorization + validation rules
body:
Goal: enforce central authority-only mutations and validate requests.

Scope:
- authorization checks per operation
- input validation and error model

Acceptance Criteria:
- unauthorized operations rejected with clear errors
- invalid payloads rejected consistently
- negative cases covered in tests

Rubric focus: Functionality, Reliability

title: Identity management services
body:
Goal: implement create, update, and status change flows.

Scope:
- create new identity
- update permitted fields
- change status with transition checks

Acceptance Criteria:
- invalid transitions rejected
- updates on revoked IDs rejected
- deterministic handling of repeated operations
- idempotent behavior documented

Rubric focus: Functionality, Reliability

title: Verification strategies (org-specific)
body:
Goal: implement per-organisation verification rules.

Scope:
- tax authority
- driving licence authority
- local authority
- bank/employer minimal response

Acceptance Criteria:
- tax: active + reporting period constraints
- driving licence: active + restriction flags
- local authority: active + residency eligibility
- bank/employer: validity-only response

Rubric focus: Functionality, Professional behavior

title: Audit logging
body:
Goal: record key actions for traceability.

Scope:
- create, update, status change, verification
- actor and timestamp

Acceptance Criteria:
- log entries created for all key actions
- actor and timestamp included
- log printable for demo

Rubric focus: Reliability, Communication

title: CLI demo runner (scripted)
body:
Goal: build deterministic console demo flow.

Scope:
- scripted scenario that covers success + failure paths
- clean output for video

Acceptance Criteria:
- deterministic output
- includes at least one failure and one success case
- output is clear and structured

Rubric focus: Technical Communication

title: Unit test suite (pytest)
body:
Goal: implement tests for core rules and edge cases.

Scope:
- domain rules
- service flows
- org-specific verification

Acceptance Criteria:
- each org rule has positive and negative test
- status history and restriction periods tested
- tests cover invalid transitions and update rules

Rubric focus: Testing & Verification

title: CI pipeline (GitHub Actions)
body:
Goal: build automated test pipeline.

Scope:
- workflow on push and PR
- pytest execution

Acceptance Criteria:
- workflow runs on push and PR
- pytest executes successfully
- python version pinned (3.11 or 3.12)

Rubric focus: Testing & CI

title: README + architecture overview
body:
Goal: provide clear usage and structure docs.

Scope:
- run instructions
- architecture overview and package map
- repo link and demo summary

Acceptance Criteria:
- run instructions are accurate
- architecture and components clearly explained
- demo scenario summarized

Rubric focus: Technical Communication

title: Video demo script
body:
Goal: concise demo outline for 10-minute video.

Scope:
- architecture explanation
- walkthrough of workflows and tests
- CI proof

Acceptance Criteria:
- under 10 minutes
- clear sequence of talking points
- includes live CLI demo plan

Rubric focus: Technical Communication

title: Development evidence (commits + board hygiene)
body:
Goal: show organized development evidence.

Scope:
- incremental commits tied to issues
- board status kept up to date

Acceptance Criteria:
- commit history shows steady progression
- issues updated one at a time
- board statuses reflect actual work

Rubric focus: Version Control & Development Evidence
